Context: Major Penalties.-

On receipt of articles of charge, the Government servant shall be required to submit his written statement of defence or whether to be heard in person within 15 days which may be extended to further 15 days at a time up to a maximum of 45 days from the date of  
receipt of articles of charge.  
- Notfn., dated 2-6-2017 and GID (53) below Rule 14.
